'''Sheeshoo''' was a tree spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who who talked to Ewoks by shaking leaves in high branches. "Sheeshoo" was also a popular name given to [[Gender/Legends|female]] Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheeshoo was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
